title: Exact-supercell finite-size sensitivity for LLZTO occupancy realization 0
research_question: Does doubling the periodic cell at fixed occupancy topology alter the 800 K tracer or collective transport estimate?
primary_estimands: 188-atom versus 94-atom tracer diffusivity ratio at 800 K
188-atom versus 94-atom collective diffusivity ratio at 800 K
188-atom versus 94-atom collective-to-tracer ratio difference at 800 K
stopping_rule: The sensitivity is interpretable only when both the 94-atom reference point and the matched 188-atom point independently pass all tracer or collective convergence criteria for the corresponding estimator.

gates.criterion: Run only after the full universal-potential domain gate passes.
The 188-atom structure must be an exact integer-matrix replication of the same ordered 94-atom occupancy realization, not a second occupancy draw.

runs.purpose: Matched 188-atom exact supercell control for formal-occ00-vel1701 at 800 K.
